prompt:
独立复核Pi PR239固定head 50c710f97b997d8b3cfd28810bf3cfde46a72e76 的WORKFLOW组件，作者OpenAI。其余SDK/预留/执行逻辑另送审。目标是固定已测runtime、防重调、国内DeepSeek/Qwen各1调用，无tools/资金/合并部署。模型费用非免费；代Claude须标非原生。以下完整文件，12/12测试与SDK0request初始化通过，云调用待验。只审给定组件，给JSON {verdict:approve|revise|reject,head_sha,findings:[{severity,code,reason}],limitations:[]}；不自称测试/看全仓。

FILE .github/workflows/pi-cloud.yml
name: Pi cloud two-provider Skill audit smoke
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['config/pi-cloud*', 'config/pi-cloud-runtime/**', 'scripts/pi-cloud*.mjs', 'scripts/lib/pi-cloud.mjs', 'scripts/tests/pi-cloud.test.mjs', '.github/workflows/pi-cloud.yml']
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['config/pi-cloud.json', 'config/pi-cloud-runtime/**', 'scripts/pi-cloud*.mjs', 'scripts/lib/pi-cloud.mjs', 'scripts/tests/pi-cloud.test.mjs', '.github/workflows/pi-cloud.yml']
permissions: {contents: read}
concurrency: {group: pi-cloud-skill-audit, cancel-in-progress: false}
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '24'}
      - run: node --test scripts/tests/pi-cloud.test.mjs
  smoke:
    needs: verify
    if: github.repository == 'ltzyz2181-collab/ltzzz' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions: {contents: write}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}', fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '24'}
      - name: Set runtime paths from runner environment, not job-level runner context
        run: |
          printf 'PI_RUNTIME_ROOT=%s/ltzzz-pi-runtime-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'PI_RECEIPT_ROOT=%s\n' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Freeze exact reviewed runtime before any receipt transport rebase
        run: node scripts/pi-cloud.mjs stage
      - run: npm ci --prefix "$PI_RUNTIME_ROOT/config/pi-cloud-runtime" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Verify actual pinned SDK and zero-request session initialization
        env: {PI_OFFLINE: '1'}
        run: node "$PI_RUNTIME_ROOT/scripts/pi-cloud-sdk-check.mjs"
      - id: prepare
        run: node "$PI_RUNTIME_ROOT/scripts/pi-cloud.mjs" prepare
      - name: Persist one reservation before any model request
        run: |
          git config user.name ltzzz-bot
          git config user.email bot@ltzzz.com
          git add knowledge/results/pi-cloud/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then exit 0; fi
          git commit -m 'Reserve Pi Skill audit once, no funds'
          node tools/push-receipt-commit.mjs
      - name: Two distinct domestic providers via pinned Pi SDK, no retries or tools
        if: steps.prepare.outputs.execute == 'true'
        env:
          DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          DEEPSEEK_MODEL: ${{ vars.DEEPSEEK_MODEL }}
          DASHSCOPE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DASHSCOPE_API_KEY || secrets.QWEN_API_KEY }}
          DASHSCOPE_MODEL: ${{ vars.DASHSCOPE_MODEL || vars.QWEN_MODEL || 'qwen-plus' }}
          DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL || vars.QWEN_BASE_URL }}
          PI_OFFLINE: '1'
          NODE_OPTIONS: --dns-result-order=ipv4first
        run: node "$PI_RUNTIME_ROOT/scripts/pi-cloud.mjs" execute
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with: {name: 'pi-cloud-${{ github.run_id }}', path: knowledge/results/pi-cloud/, retention-days: 30}
      - name: Preserve output or uncertain status without replay
        if: always() && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          git config user.name ltzzz-bot
          git config user.email bot@ltzzz.com
          git add knowledge/results/pi-cloud/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then exit 0; fi
          git commit -m 'Record real Pi SDK model outputs, not deployment or cash settlement'
          node tools/push-receipt-commit.mjs
